title.en: Watch the TTL drop hop by hop
title.hinglish: TTL ko hop by hop ghatte dekho

why.en: Traceroute sends packets with TTL 1, 2, 3 and so on, and each router that drops one reveals itself.
why.hinglish: Traceroute TTL 1, 2, 3 waghera ke packets bhejta hai, aur jo router unhe drop karta hai woh apna address bata deta hai.

expect.en: A numbered list of router addresses with round-trip times, starting with your home router. Some hops may show * if they do not answer. The path differs per network.
expect.hinglish: Router addresses ki numbered list round-trip times ke saath, tumhare home router se shuru. Kuch hops * dikha sakte hain agar woh jawab na dein. Path har network par alag hota hai.

title.en: Check the TTL in a reply

why.en: The reply TTL is the server's starting TTL minus the routers crossed, so it hints at distance.
why.hinglish: Reply ka TTL server ke starting TTL minus crossed routers hota hai, isliye yeh distance ka hint deta hai.

expect.en: Lines like 'TTL=54' (Windows) or 'ttl=54' (Linux/macOS). The value varies by server and path.
expect.hinglish: 'TTL=54' (Windows) ya 'ttl=54' (Linux/macOS) jaisi lines. Value server aur path ke hisaab se badalti hai.

why.en: Your laptop uses it to decide between local delivery and the default gateway.
why.hinglish: Laptop ise use karke decide karta hai ki local delivery karni hai ya default gateway ko bhejna hai.

expect.en: A default route (0.0.0.0/0) via your router plus a route for your local network such as 192.168.1.0/24. On macOS use netstat -rn.
expect.hinglish: Tumhare router se default route (0.0.0.0/0) aur local network ka route jaise 192.168.1.0/24. macOS par netstat -rn use karo.

title.en: Inspect IP header fields in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein IP header fields dekho

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark and filter to see TTL, DF and fragment flags.
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur TTL, DF aur fragment flags dekhne ke liye filter lagao.

expect.en: Packets with a lowered TTL and, in the fragment scenario, the two fragments with MF and a fragment offset.
expect.hinglish: Kam hue TTL wale packets aur, fragment scenario mein, MF aur fragment offset wale do fragments.
